text: {"lessons":["I should judge each holding by its future prospects, not just whether it is above or below my purchase price; refusing to admit a mistake can turn a manageable loss into a larger one.","Selling a small gain felt satisfying, but I should avoid taking profits too quickly while leaving losing positions unattended; decisions should follow a consistent plan.","Doing nothing through repeated account declines was not a strategy. I should review the portfolio regularly and make deliberate, risk-aware choices rather than letting losses grow by default."]}
